os:object-store.name: eip-pm-receipts-store
os:object-store.doc:name: Process Manager Reply Receipts Object Store

flow.name: process-manager-start-order
flow.doc:description: Process manager trigger: validates the order, creates the process state (RUNNING, history) in the persistent store and sends the first step, PAYMENT; 202 with the processId.

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or isEmpty(payload.sku) or (not (payload.amount is Number)) or (payload.amount <= 0) or (not (payload.quantity is Number)) or (payload.quantity <= 0) or ((payload.quantity mod 1) != 0)]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Invalid order
raise-error.description: orderId, sku, a positive amount and a positive integer quantity are required

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { processId: "PM-" ++ uuid(), orderId: payload.orderId, order: { amount: payload.amount, sku: payload.sku, quantity: payload.quantity }, status: "RUNNING", currentStep: "PAYMENT", history: [], startedAt: now() as String }

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log process started
logger.message: #['Process ' ++ vars.vState.processId ++ ' started for orderId=' ++ vars.vState.orderId ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

set-payload.doc:name: Set Started Response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- vars.vState filterObject ((v, k) -> (k as String) != 'history')]

flow.name: process-manager-receive-reply
flow.doc:description: Process manager reply endpoint: correlates a step's reply by processId, applies it once per process and step, decides the next step (or the end) from the outcome, stores the state and sends the next command; 404 unknown process, 409 ended process or unexpected step, 200 DUPLICATE for a repeat.

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.processId) or isEmpty(payload.step) or isEmpty(payload.outcome)]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Invalid reply
raise-error.description: processId, step and outcome are required

choice.doc:name: Check Process Can Take The Reply

raise-error.doc:name: Raise CONFLICT Error - Unexpected step
raise-error.description: #['Process is waiting for ' ++ vars.vState.currentStep ++ ', not ' ++ vars.vReply.step]

os:store.doc:name: Claim Reply Receipt
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: vars.vReply.outcome, receivedAt: now() as String }]

on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue (a copy was applied first)

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log duplicate reply
logger.message: #['Duplicate ' ++ vars.vReply.step ++ ' reply for process ' ++ vars.vReply.processId ++ ' ignored, correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

set-payload.doc:name: Set Duplicate Response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { processId: vars.vReply.processId, step: vars.vReply.step, result: 'DUPLICATE', status: vars.vState.status, currentStep: vars.vState.currentStep }]

set-payload.doc:name: Set Applied Response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { processId: vars.vState.processId, step: vars.vReply.step, result: 'APPLIED', status: vars.vState.status, currentStep: vars.vState.currentStep }]

sub-flow.name: sf-decide-next-step
sub-flow.doc:description: The manager's rules: from the step and its outcome, the next step and the process status; an outcome the step does not have is 400.

sub-flow.name: sf-apply-reply
sub-flow.doc:description: Records the reply in the history, moves the process to the decided status and step, stores it, and sends the next command when there is one.

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var ended = vars.vDecision.nextStep == null --- vars.vState ++ { status: vars.vDecision.status, currentStep: vars.vDecision.nextStep, history: vars.vState.history << { step: vars.vReply.step, event: "REPLY", outcome: vars.vReply.outcome, reference: vars.vReply.reference, at: now() as String } } ++ (if (ended) { endedAt: now() as String } else {})

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log decision
logger.message: #['Process ' ++ vars.vState.processId ++ ': ' ++ vars.vReply.step ++ ' ' ++ vars.vReply.outcome ++ ' -> ' ++ vars.vState.status ++ ' ' ++ (vars.vState.currentStep default 'end') ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

sub-flow.name: sf-send-step-command
sub-flow.doc:description: Records the command for vars.vState.currentStep in the history, stores the state before sending (the reply can come back before the 202 does), and POSTs the command to the step's service; when it cannot be sent the process is stored SUSPENDED and the caller gets 503.

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.vState ++ { history: vars.vState.history << { step: vars.vState.currentStep, event: "SENT", at: now() as String } }

http:request.doc:name: POST Step Command To Service
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { processId: vars.vState.processId, step: vars.vState.currentStep, orderId: vars.vState.orderId } ++ vars.vState.order]

on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue (command not sent, suspend)

logger.doc:name: WARN: Log command not sent
logger.message: #['Process ' ++ vars.vState.processId ++ ' could not send ' ++ vars.vState.currentStep ++ ' (' ++ error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ '), suspended, correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

set-variable.doc:name: SET vState
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- vars.vState ++ { status: 'SUSPENDED', lastError: error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier }]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE Error - Step not sent
raise-error.description: #['Step ' ++ vars.vState.currentStep ++ ' could not be sent; process ' ++ vars.vState.processId ++ ' is SUSPENDED']

flow.name: process-manager-get-process
flow.doc:description: GET /eip/process-manager/processes/{processId}: the process state (status, currentStep, history); 404 for an unknown processId.
